# Support

Need help with GitDesktop? Here's where to look.

## Using GitDesktop

- **Start with the [README](https://github.com/theBGuy/GitDesktop#readme)** — it
  covers requirements (`git`, `gh`, an optional AI provider), setup, and what each
  feature does.
- **AI setup** (providers, keys, custom instructions, AI-ignore patterns) is
  documented in the README's *AI configuration* section.

## Questions & discussion

For "how do I…?", configuration help, or to share an idea before filing it, use
**[GitHub Discussions](https://github.com/theBGuy/GitDesktop/discussions)**. This
keeps the issue tracker focused on confirmed bugs and concrete feature requests.

## Found a bug or have a feature request?

Open an issue with the right [template](https://github.com/theBGuy/GitDesktop/issues/new/choose):

- **Bug report** — something is broken or behaving unexpectedly.
- **Feature request** — an idea or improvement.

## Security issues

Please **do not** open a public issue for security vulnerabilities. Follow the
private reporting process in
[SECURITY.md](https://github.com/theBGuy/GitDesktop/blob/master/SECURITY.md).

## Contributing

Want to fix it yourself? See
[CONTRIBUTING.md](https://github.com/theBGuy/GitDesktop/blob/master/CONTRIBUTING.md).
